description: Running jobs on a Slurm cluster — login, transfers, sbatch / srun, job templates, modules, conda, GPUs, Jupyter

cheats.title: SSH shortcut that asks for 2FA only once
cheats.notes: Put this in ~/.ssh/config, then just  ssh hpc. Logins within 10 minutes reuse the connection, so Duo / 2FA asks only once.

cheats.title: Which machine am I on?
cheats.notes: Login nodes can differ between logins — check before reattaching to tmux

cheats.title: Copy a file to the cluster
Copy a file from the cluster
rsync a folder to the cluster
cheats.notes: Trailing slashes = copy the contents. -P shows progress and resumes.

cheats.title: Hold / release a pending job
cheats.notes: Let it go again with  scontrol release <jobid>

cheats.title: How efficient was a job (CPU / memory)
Batch script template
cheats.notes: Run  mkdir -p logs  first — Slurm won't create the folder. %x = job name, %j = job id.

cheats.title: GPU lines for a batch script
Job array lines
cheats.notes: Each task gets $SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID. %A = array job id, %a = task number. Limit how many run at once with --array=1-100%10

cheats.title: Email me when the job ends or fails
Search for software
cheats.notes: module avail lists everything that's loadable right now

cheats.title: Start Jupyter on a compute node
cheats.notes: Run inside an interactive session, note the node name (hostname), then open the tunnel from your Mac

cheats.title: Tunnel to Jupyter from your Mac
cheats.notes: Then open http://localhost:8888 in your browser

cheats.title: Keep work alive after disconnecting
cheats.notes: Start tmux on the login node, run things inside it, detach with prefix d. Next time: tmux attach -t work (on the same login node).
